t: The Timberland Pro Sawhorse 2.0 safety boots deliver professional-grade protection for demanding worksites. Featuring a robust 200J steel toe cap and composite penetration-resistant midsole, these wheat leather boots meet S1P safety standards with anti-static and slip-resistant SRC-rated soles. The shock-absorbing heel and sole construction provides all-day comfort, whilst the padded collar and tongue ensure a secure, comfortable fit. Built for tradespeople who require reliable steel toe cap boots that combine durability with comfort, these classic safety boots offer essential foot protection without compromising on performance.
b: Not Tested for Sole Heat Resistance
